title: Arming verified
description: BALDUR-0's ARMING_VERIFIED record: the verification of the arming act that covers the run, before it starts (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §5.4, §12; the Director's ruling on U21, 26 October 2026). Without a valid act, ODIN's rung is HUMAN_ONLY and the run does not start. Fields with no subject are null (§16 U15).

sha256.description: The act file's exact signed bytes.

reason.description: Null when the act passes. PLAN_NOT_LISTED: a plan of the run's chain is not in the act's plan_chain_hashes (§16.2 U18).
